task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS S3 bucket name and returns True if it follows AWS naming conventions (lowercase, 3-63 characters, no consecutive dots), False otherwise.
Create a JSON object that represents an AWS IAM policy allowing a principal to read objects from a specific S3 bucket with ARN 'arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*'.
Write a regular expression that matches valid AWS IAM role names (alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores only, 1-64 characters long).
